credential_type.quote: A certificate of registration is necessary for each 'business entity' regardless of the fact that each entity may be owned by the same individual.

is_mandatory.quote: A person shall not undertake, offer to undertake, or submit a bid to do work as a contractor on a structure unless that person has a current, valid certificate of registration for all construction work issued by the board.

title_protection.quote: Use of the word 'license' in any form of advertising when only registered may subject the registrant or those required to be registered to a fine of one hundred dollars ($100) for each offense at the discretion of the board.

scope_protection.quote: A person shall not undertake, offer to undertake, or submit a bid to do work as a contractor on a structure unless that person has a current, valid certificate of registration for all construction work issued by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated § 5-65-3 or any other provision of this chapter or the regulations promulgated thereunder.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: That the registrant or applicant has violated § 5-65-3 or any other provision of this chapter or the regulations promulgated thereunder.

disciplinary_grounds.description: The insurance required by § 5-65-7 is not currently in effect.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: That the insurance required by § 5-65-7 is not currently in effect.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in conduct as a contractor that is dishonest or fraudulent and injurious to the welfare of the public.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: That the registrant, licensee, or applicant has engaged in conduct as a contractor that is dishonest or fraudulent that the board or office finds injurious to the welfare of the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated a rule or order of the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated a rule or order of the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly assisted an unregistered person to act in violation of this chapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: That the registrant has knowingly assisted an unregistered person to act in violation of this chapter or the regulations promulgated thereunder.

disciplinary_grounds.description: A lien was filed on a structure because the registrant wrongfully failed to perform a contractual duty to pay money to the lienholder.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: That a lien was filed on a structure under chapter 28 of title 34 because the registrant or applicant wrongfully failed to perform a contractual duty to pay money to the person claiming the lien.
That the registrant has violated state building codes.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Made false or fraudulent statements on the registration application.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: That the registrant has made false or fraudulent statements on his or her application.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in repeated acts in violation of this chapter, including substandard workmanship and misuse of registration.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: That a registrant has engaged in repeated acts in violation of this chapter and the board's rules and regulations inclusive of substandard workmanship and any misuse of registration.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performed or arranged work while the registration was suspended, invalidated, or revoked.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The board or office may take disciplinary action against a contractor who performed work, or arranged to perform work, while the registration was suspended, invalidated, or revoked.
That the registrant breached a contract.
That the registrant performed negligent and/or improper work.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertised with a license number when only registered.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: That the contractor has advertised with a license number when only registered.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to complete a project(s) for construction or willfully failed to comply with the terms of a contract or written warranty.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: That the registrant has failed to complete a project(s) for construction or willfully failed to comply with the terms of a contract or written warranty.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misrepresented registration status as valid when it was suspended, revoked, invalidated, inactive, or unregistered.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: That the registrant has misrepresented his or her registration status as valid when the registration was suspended, revoked, invalidated, inactive, or unregistered as required by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to pay a fine or comply with any order issued by the board or office.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: That the registrant has failed to pay a fine or comply with any order issued by the board or office.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to obtain or maintain the required continuing education/units required by the board, or failed to sign the required statement.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: That the registrant has failed to obtain or maintain the required continuing education/units required by the board, or failed to sign the statement required by the board for registration or renewal.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated provisions of specified labor and wage law chapters.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: That the registrant has violated any of the provisions of chapter 3 of title 25; chapter 3, 12, 14, 36, or 50 of title 28; or chapter 13 of title 37.

bonding_required.quote: The board may, at its discretion, require any contractor who has had action taken against his/her registration to obtain a bond in such amount as determined by the board.

insurance_required.quote: Throughout the period of registration, the contractor shall have in effect public liability and property damage insurance covering the work of that contractor that shall be subject to this chapter in not less than the following amount: five hundred thousand dollars ($500,000) combined single limit, bodily injury and property damage.

definition_quote.value: Contractor means a person who, in the pursuit of an independent business, undertakes or offers to undertake or submits a bid, or for compensation and with or without the intent to sell the structure constructs, alters, repairs, improves, moves over public highways, roads, or streets, or demolishes a structure or to perform any work in connection with the construction, alteration, repair, improvement, moving over public highways, roads, or streets, or demolition of a structure, and the appurtenances thereto.
definition_quote.quote: "Contractor" means a person who, in the pursuit of an independent business, undertakes or offers to undertake or submits a bid, or for compensation and with or without the intent to sell the structure constructs, alters, repairs, improves, moves over public highways, roads, or streets, or demolishes a structure or to perform any work in connection with the construction, alteration, repair, improvement, moving over public highways, roads, or streets, or demolition of a structure, and the appurtenances thereto.

methods_authorized.quote: constructs, alters, repairs, improves, moves over public highways, roads, or streets, or demolishes a structure or to perform any work in connection with the construction, alteration, repair, improvement, moving over public highways, roads, or streets, or demolition of a structure

registration_number_required_in_ads.quote: The registration number of each contractor shall appear in any advertising by that contractor.

insurance_personal_injury_minimum_usd.quote: not less than the following amount: five hundred thousand dollars ($500,000) combined single limit, bodily injury and property damage.

insurance_property_damage_minimum_usd.quote: not less than the following amount: five hundred thousand dollars ($500,000) combined single limit, bodily injury and property damage.

contract_must_be_written.quote: All work performed, including labor and materials, in excess of one thousand dollars ($1,000) shall be accompanied by a contract in writing.

right_of_rescission_days.quote: any consumer who is an elderly person shall, in the absence of an emergency as defined herein, have three (3) days within which to cancel the in-home solicitation contract for contractor services.

minimum_project_value_usd.quote: A person working on one structure or project, under one or more contracts when the price of all of that person's contracts for labor, materials, and all other items is less than five hundred dollars ($500) and the work is of a casual, minor, or inconsequential nature.

state_preempts_local_registration_fees.quote: The provisions of this chapter shall be exclusive and no city or town shall require or shall issue any registrations or licenses nor charge any fee for the regulatory registration of any contractor registered with the board.

local_trade_licensing_preserved.quote: Nothing in this subsection shall limit or abridge the authority of any city or town to license and levy and collect a general and nondiscriminatory license fee levied upon all businesses

registration_renewal_interval_years.quote: A certificate of registration shall be valid for one (1) year from the date of issuance unless the registration is revoked or suspended as described in § 5-65-10.

scope__voidable_contract_clauses.item: Liability limitation clause (limiting contractor liability to cost of inspection report or contract price)
Indemnification / hold-harmless clause favoring the promisee's sole negligence
Waiver of consumer cancellation rights clause
Waiver of consumer rights (general statutory rights) clause
Blank spaces clause (material terms left blank for later completion)
Assignment of insurance proceeds clause (without owner consent / in violation of statutory requirements)
Clause authorizing unlawful entry or breach of peace for repossession
Lien disclosure notice omission (failure to include required lien disclosure)
Disclaimer or limitation of implied warranty clause
Clause entered into by unlicensed contractor (contract with unlicensed contractor)
Clause requiring compliance waiver from applicable building codes or zoning regulations
Distributed energy contract clause failing to meet statutory disclosure or terms requirements
